about: Photo test set for phase 1.4 (D7). Photos stay on their sites; fork/tools/fetch_eval_photos.py downloads them into build/. Macros are the recipe pages' own per-serving figures (site calculators, not lab values). LIDO photos (lv-lido-*) are the chain's own Wolt menu photos; LIDO publishes no macros for restaurant dishes, so per_serving is null there except where LIDO's packaged label gives them. match_kcal_100g_max: the dish's table row must be at most this energy (a cooked row, not the raw grain). user_note: what a person would type with the photo; the test runs each such photo with and without it. parts: the things on a set-meal plate, each named by any of its words.
collected: 2026-10-18, LIDO and eda.ru 2026-10-23, LIDO set meals 2026-10-24
